title: AI Literacy for All
summary: Online and in-person sessions that equip people with practical knowledge of AI tools and best practices.
body: Looking at the surrounding community, we realised that most people only used a handful of AI tools. We set out to introduce them to a wider range of tools and show what each one can do.

Using a few of those tools, we showed how AI can do far more than chat. The sessions covered tools that assist with research, study and media generation, along with techniques to get the best output from them.
We closed each session by highlighting the risks of AI and how to guard against them.
